Chapter 1111: 31 Comprehension (Request For Subscription)_2

Chapter 1111: Chapter 31 Comprehension (Request for Subscription)_2

However, the enemies here refer to those at least at the level of a Heavenly Venerate.

The war machines fall into the enemy’s hands, and then the enemy presents them to the Heavenly Venerates. The Heavenly Venerates study and replicate them, and this is the complete process of the Chaos Secrets leaking out.

And Lin Yuan?

Having just entered the level of a Great Lord, his achievements in Chaos Evolution are not high, so he wants to study more of the Chaos Secret Patterns. However, he is still far from comprehending the complete Chaos Secret Patterns on any war machine.

Moreover, when Lin Yuan studies the war machines, it is under the watchful eyes of the Red Pine King, making it even less likely for any leak to occur.

The most crucial point is that Lin Yuan has awakened his Fierce Sun Divine Body, equivalent to someone on the side of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, with no reason to betray the ancient country.

“Father’s insight…”

The young man was sincerely convinced. On the surface, it seemed that the Red Pine King agreed to let the Galaxy Great Venerate study the Alpha-level war machines as a reward for defeating the Thunder Spear Great Honored.

In reality, it was a multi-layered scheme, virtually eliminating any risk.

“With father’s strategy, King Spirit Might will surely be defeated in this war.”

The young man immediately said.

“It’s still too early to talk about victory or defeat.”

The Red Pine King shook his head, with a tone of worry, “I always have a vague feeling that King Spirit Might has many hidden safeguards.”

…

Leaving the small city cave abode where the Red Pine King resided.

Lord Qingfen looked at Lin Yuan, his tone slightly solemn, “Disciple, Prince Red Pine promised so readily, probably because he saw something unusual about you.”

Lord Qingfen understood the importance of war machines, especially the Alpha-level ones. If there weren’t significant benefits, how could the Red Pine King allow Lin Yuan to study them?

This refers to benefits, not merely the absence of risk.

“But he only saw something unusual about you; he would never think that your bloodline concentration would reach the core royal family level.”

Lord Qingfen said.

Lord Qingfen deduced that Lin Yuan had the core royal bloodline, based on Lin Yuan’s terrifying speed of growth without stepping into the Great Lord realm.

Lord Qingfen was unaware of this, at most noticing some clues from Lin Yuan’s activation of the Fierce Sun Divine Body, but not directly linking it to the core royal bloodline.

Otherwise, the previous conversation wouldn’t have happened as it did.

“Hmm.”

Lin Yuan listened on the side.

“There shouldn’t be any problems.”

Lord Qingfen thought repeatedly, “At most, Prince Red Pine just thinks your royal bloodline is a bit more potent. With Prince Red Pine’s character, he probably won’t even mention it.”

Among the crowned kings of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, Prince Red Pine is the least ambitious, and he is also disinclined to participate in the internal strife and conflicts among the members of the ancient royal family.

…

Parting ways with Lord Qingfen.

Lin Yuan was directly transferred from the original Ding Seven Defense Line battlefield.

He went instead to a battlefield line relatively closer to the core defense line.

Of course, Lin Yuan left an avatar at the original Ding Seven Defense Line battlefield to study the war machines there.

Since the Red Pine King agreed to let Lin Yuan study even Alpha-level war machines, the other Beta-level and Gamma-level war machines were naturally at Lin Yuan’s discretion.

“Is this the core defense line battlefield?”

One of Lin Yuan’s avatars arrived at the core defense line battlefield.

The area was covered in layers of killing arrays, with war machines densely arranged, the breath of peak Great Lords rising and falling.

Lin Yuan’s avatar quickly came before an Alpha-level war machine.

Due to the current phase of confrontation, both sides had not yet engaged in battle, and many war machines remained stationary.

“Galaxy Great Venerate.”

The controller of the Alpha-level war machine saw Lin Yuan approaching and slightly bowed, saying, “Prince Red Pine has already given the order. The Galaxy Great Venerate can study this war machine at any time.”

Even though the controller of the Alpha-level war machine only possessed the strength of a peak ruler, they directly obeyed the Red Pine King, with even peak Great Lords unable to command them.

Without the Red Pine King’s orders, no one could approach the war machines without cause.

“Hmm.”

Lin Yuan nodded and directly flew into the Alpha-level war machine.

“These Chaos Secret Patterns…” Lin Yuan was astonished upon entering.

Compared to the Chaos Secret Patterns within the highest level Beta-class war machines he had encountered.

The Chaos Secret Patterns contained within the Alpha-level war machines were not only more vast, but also more ‘complete’…

“Chaos is the source of everything, and also the beginning of everything…”

Lin Yuan immersed himself in observing the Chaos Secret Patterns spread across the war machine.

The Chaos Rule does not exist within any complete world, which is why the Chaos Rule cannot be directly comprehended.

Chaos gives rise to all things; only by comprehending all things can one indirectly enhance their understanding of the Chaos Rule.

But these Chaos Secret Patterns before him had been forcefully reverted to their origin by some great existence, who forcibly condensed the fundamental patterns of chaos from all things.

[Your perception defies the heavens, observing unknown secret patterns, enhancing your understanding of the Chaos Rule…..]

Lin Yuan feels the Chaos Secret Patterns contained within the Grade A war machines, and his own understanding of the Chaos Rule is continuously improving.

…

Lin Yuan sends out thirty-three avatars, heading to various defense line battlefields to comprehend the war machines.

As for his true body, it remains stationed at the Ding Seven Defense Line battlefield.

As for the two Primordial Spirits… they have long left the battlefield, hidden in an extremely safe place.

“Hmm?”

“Starting the attack again?”

The true body stationed at the Ding Seven Defense Line battlefield is also comprehending the war machine at this battlefield, and sensing the change in external aura, it immediately flies out.

“Great Venerate Changfeng.”

Lin Yuan looks at a Great Venerate who stands opposed to him from afar.

Great Venerate Changfeng, a veteran and seasoned Great Venerate, his strength is also close to the peak of the Great Venerate, which is why Prince Red Pine arranged for Lin Yuan to stop him.

“Galaxy Great Venerate.”

Having learned from the example of Thunder Spear Great Honored, Great Venerate Changfeng naturally dares not underestimate Lin Yuan.

Rumble.

Soon.

The two are engaged in a fierce battle.

“This Great Venerate Changfeng…”

Lin Yuan originally thought he would have to fight hard, but upon first engaging with Great Venerate Changfeng, he found that the opponent quickly retreats, just touching briefly.

There was not the same air of desperate struggle that Thunder Spear Great Honored had with Lin Yuan previously.

“Indeed.”

Lin Yuan rethinks and finds it normal.

To cultivate to the realm of Great Venerate, and being a seasoned veteran, who among them isn’t a cunning fox?

Except for a few, like Thunder Spear Great Honored, almost none of the Great Venerates truly wish to fight desperately with enemies on the battlefield.

Great Venerate Changfeng acts this way, and Lin Yuan secretly cooperates.

After all, the task Prince Red Pine gave him was simply to block Great Venerate Changfeng.

…

Chaos Void.

“It seems only by comprehending the divine imprint of ‘Fierce Sun’s Creation’, thoroughly replicating it here, can I attempt to coagulate the source of Fierce Sun and bind it with the internal universe…”

Lin Yuan deliberates to himself.

The seventh physical body divine ability ‘Fierce Sun’s Creation’, carries the meaning of opening up and stabilizing the universe, hence Lin Yuan plans to try forming a stable Fierce Sun source within his internal universe.

“Continue cultivating ‘Infinite Void’ second tier.”

Lin Yuan resumes training the thirteen-tier inheritance ‘Infinite Void’.

This inheritance can elevate Lin Yuan’s foundation to an incredible height.

…..

Deep within the internal universe.

Beside the Jade Gourd, a red-cloth-covered girl is sleeping soundly.

At this moment.

Lin Yuan condenses an avatar that appears not far away.

“Senior.”

Lin Yuan calls.

“I’ve told you long ago, once you’ve passed the test you’re my master, don’t need to call me senior.”

The red-cloth-covered girl opens her eyes, though she tells Lin Yuan not to call her that, the joy on her face overflows.

“Alright.”

“What would you like from me?”

The red-cloth-covered girl asks.

“I want to ask, in my cultivation of ‘Infinite Void’ second tier recently, is there anything wrong…”

Though Lin Yuan’s perception defies the heavens, ‘Infinite Void’ is a thirteen-tier inheritance, enormously intricate and profound,

so Lin Yuan fears he might stray off the right path, and periodically asks the red-cloth-covered girl.

“Is there anything wrong?”

The red-cloth-covered girl rolls her eyes, since Lin Yuan began training the second tier, she has been observing, hoping to find problems in Lin Yuan’s cultivation.

In order to prove her usefulness.

But the result… she, the dignified Spirit of Jade Gourd, a great being specifically created for guiding future cultivators of the ‘Infinite Void’ inheritance, ended up unable to offer a single suggestion.
